scope: Independent knowledge-tool/source/portable artifact review; no runtime changes or production calls.

findings.before: JSON/Markdown valid + obsolete local HTML returned check exit0; HTML overlays were outside material identity coverage.
findings.after: Present ignored HTML is compared against render(data); absent ignored HTML explicitly permitted in clean clones with a message.
findings.evidence: Actual check/render functions: obsolete present HTML exit1; absent HTML exit0; 4 independent regressions passed.

findings.before: Backend MCP fallback with 7 tools and no client inventory yielded only1 tool with current=True. The loop used its newly appended first row as deduplication evidence.
findings.after: Client MCP paths are captured before backend loop. All7 backend tools survive; existing7 client tools are not duplicated.
findings.evidence: Actual mechanism_overlay: fallback7/7 and client-prefilled7/7; source current flags true.

findings.before: Saved classification had no portable terrain identity check; refreshed terrain could retain stale evidence while material SHA coverage stayed green.
findings.after: terrain_sha256 and count/category checks run via --check in check-project-knowledge.sh; no local raw Graphify artifact is needed for CI.
findings.evidence: Existing new regression checks unchanged identity accepted, changed terrain bytes rejected and missing records rejected; all6 root regressions passed.

findings.before: 8 risky mechanisms claimed, but backend probes contain7 risk mechanisms plus1 AST inventory fixture.
findings.after: Acceptance now says7 risky mechanisms and inventory fixture.
findings.evidence: Compared all8 named cases in backend-mechanism-probes evidence; count now agrees.

tests.includes: Isolated Node fixture ran, not skipped

cycle_assessment: No self-hash cycle found: terrain generated outputs and code-review evidence excluded from terrain inputs; classifier output references terrain SHA and is not a terrain input; HTML render reads overlays without hashing itself; material registry excludes itself/pointer. Backend/client generators do not read review ledger.
claim_assessment: Backend counts/7+1 probes and F01-F07/F14 agree with our source/probe evidence. Production observations, restore, external historical materials, notebooks and browser visual acceptance are other agents evidence, not independently repeated here.
limits: Static/Babel/AST identity is not semantic correctness, execution coverage or dynamic import/dispatch proof.
Node-dependent inventory test intentionally skips in stdlib-only job and is rerun after npm ci in frontend CI.
Ignored HTML absence is permitted for portable clean CI; --render is necessary to view local map.
Final root-owned regeneration, materials identities, current ledger/source gates and overall app test run are separate integration steps.
